newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville lowers Friday power prices by $3-4/MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville lowers Friday power prices by $3-4/MWh.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) lowered its price offers for power during heavy load hours on Friday by $3.00 to 4.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Thursday.
BPA continued to limit firm sales during heavy-load blocks (hours ending 0800-2200 PST) to 500 megawatts, but no limits were placed on other offers.
Firm heavy-load power was offered at $17.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $18.00 for California-Oregon border (COB), down from $21.00 and $22.00, respectively for Thursday.
Firm power during light-load hours was offered at $12.75 per MWh for Friday.
Non-firm power during light-load hours on Friday was offered at $13.00 for all deliveries.
Friday non-firm power during heavy-load hours was offered at $18.00 per MWh for Northwest delivieries, down from $21.00 for Thursday. COB deliveries were offered at $19.00, down from $22.00.
